labels.ctaBody: Share your objective, constraints and current development stage. Together, we will define the scope and deliverables suited to your project.

mechanical-design.title: Mechanical design in Switzerland
mechanical-design.description: DOMTEKNIKA develops products and mechanisms for industrial companies and innovators, from the initial architecture to components prepared for industrialisation.
mechanical-design.approach: A custom mechanism, a new component or a product redesign starts with its use, loads, available space and manufacturing constraints. Material and assembly choices are considered from the outset.
mechanical-design.validation: CAD models clarify interfaces and prepare validation. Depending on the project, development continues through prototypes, calculations or refinement for production.
deliverables: Technical documentation appropriate to the development stage

prototyping.title: Product prototyping and validation
prototyping.description: DOMTEKNIKA develops prototypes to test ideas in use, verify mechanisms and prepare the next stages of product development.
prototyping.approach: A prototype should answer a specific question: verify a movement, test ergonomics or demonstrate a function. We define what must be validated before choosing its construction and level of finish.
prototyping.validation: Testing informs design iterations. A functional demonstrator and a production-representative part serve different purposes; the scope is tailored to the decision you need to make.
deliverables: Prototype or demonstrator suited to the need
Design revisions for the next development stage

simulation.title: Mechanical simulation and injection analysis
simulation.description: DOMTEKNIKA supports mechanical validation and the optimisation of moulded parts through finite element calculations and rheological analysis.
simulation.approach: Before tooling begins, calculations help study component behaviour and compare geometries. Load assumptions, materials and operating conditions define the scope of the analysis.
simulation.validation: For polymer components, the study connects mechanical performance with injection moulding constraints. Results guide geometry changes and test preparation; they do not replace the physical validation required for the project.
deliverables: Simulation results and analysis of critical areas

electronics-integration.title: Electrical and electronics integration
electronics-integration.description: DOMTEKNIKA integrates electrical and electronic functions into the mechanical architecture of products and demonstrators.
electronics-integration.approach: Development begins with the required functions and interfaces: power supply, control, components and packaging. Integration is considered alongside the mechanics to create a coherent, accessible system.
electronics-integration.validation: Our documented work includes electric mobility architectures and an automatically synchronised clock. Development depth, testing and industrial preparation are defined around each project.
deliverables: Prototype and functional checks within the agreed scope
